Jacksonville ran for 171 on 37 carries behind the five. On the projection he misses the Monday review on the field and the Wednesday practice of the Indianapolis week; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Cornelius Lucas is the chart's first reserve tackle. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
